q: What is the SI unit of force?
ai_exp:
Step-by-Step Analysis:

Step 1: Recall force definition
• Force = mass × acceleration

Step 2: Identify SI units
• Joule (J) = Energy
• Newton (N) = Force
• Watt (W) = Power
• Pascal (Pa) = Pressure

Option A (Joule): Unit of energy ✗
Option B (Newton): Unit of force ✓ Correct!
Option C (Watt): Unit of power ✗
Option D (Pascal): Unit of pressure ✗

The correct answer is B) Newton.

q: A ball is thrown vertically upward. At its highest point, its velocity is:
exp: At the highest point, the ball momentarily stops before falling.
ai_exp:
Step-by-Step Analysis:

Step 1: Understand vertical motion
• Ball thrown upward decelerates due to gravity
• At highest point, it stops momentarily

Step 2: Analyze velocity at peak
• Velocity = 0 m/s at highest point
• Then gravity pulls it back down

Option A (Maximum): Initial velocity is maximum ✗
Option B (Zero): Velocity is zero at peak ✓ Correct!
Option C (Equal to initial): Only at launch ✗
Option D (Negative): Only during descent ✗

The correct answer is B) Zero.
